draft.title: Civil war and War Communism
card: After the October Revolution, the Bolsheviks (the Reds) fought a civil war against the Whites, a mix of opponents including monarchists and others who rejected Bolshevik rule. Foreign powers also sent some support to the Whites.
The Red Army, built up under Trotsky, defeated the Whites by 1921. The Whites were divided and lacked a single aim, while the Reds held the central territory.
War Communism was the Bolsheviks' economic policy during the war. The state took control of industry and seized grain from peasants to feed the army and the cities.
Peasants lost their grain with little in return, so many grew less. Together with war damage, this helped cause a severe famine in 1921.
draft.remember: War Communism fed the Red war effort by seizing grain and industry, but it helped bring famine.

a.q: Why did the Bolsheviks introduce War Communism?
opts: To supply the army and cities during the civil war
To give peasants more freedom to sell their grain
To return factories to their former private owners
To end the war by making peace with the Whites
a.why: The state took grain and industry so that the Red Army and the cities could be supplied while the war went on. Letting peasants sell freely was not part of it: grain was seized, not traded.
a.clue: Think about what the Reds needed to keep fighting.

b.q: In 1920, Olga, a peasant near Tambov, has most of her grain taken by state officials. She plants a smaller crop the next year. What does this show about War Communism?
opts: Seizing grain gave peasants a reason to grow less
Seizing grain made food more plentiful in the cities
Seizing grain was welcomed because it ended the war
Seizing grain helped the Whites win peasant support
b.why: Peasants who lost their grain with little in return had less reason to grow it, so output fell and this helped cause famine. The seizures did not make food plentiful, since less was grown.
b.clue: What would you do if the state took your harvest?

a.best: To supply the army and cities during the civil war

b.best: Seizing grain gave peasants a reason to grow less
